svg.title: Battery (multicell)
svg.desc: Battery (multicell), IEEE 315-1975 §2.5 battery, §2.5.3 multicell: the long line is always positive. Drawn at BT1's place in the Schematex circuit exemplar (exemplar viewBox 140 648 78 64) with the same pins, revised as the manifest notes say; one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: plus (+) (30,8), minus (−) (30,56).
